content: Root cause: The bug was due to the Command Line Interface (CLI) parser improperly handling the "-dryrun" option. When the "-dryrun" argument was used, the existing CLI parser would interpret it as a missing required option and throw a `MissingOptionException`, preventing the execution of a dry run. The resolution involved modifying the argument validation logic to specifically ignore this exception when "-dryrun" was included, thereby allowing the dry run command to execute correctly without raising an error.
